verdict.rationale: Cline is itself a built-in AI coding agent inside the editor, CLI, and desktop app. It takes delegated tasks through Plan/Act, runs autonomously via Auto Approve/YOLO and headless CLI, and supports parallel subagents, Kanban agents, and cron-scheduled agents. Hands-on community reports corroborate this, describing planning with Cline, then leaving it to work on the codebase and returning to accurate diffs.
